name: Memora
description: A dynamic reviewer and examination platform that generates study material from a student's own notes.

caseStudy.overview: Memora turns raw lecture notes into structured study material — reviewers, flashcards, and quizzes — without manual authoring.
caseStudy.problem: Students spend more time reformatting notes into study material than actually studying.
caseStudy.objective: Automate the reformatting step while keeping the student in control of what gets generated.
caseStudy.solution: A pipeline that parses uploaded notes, extracts key concepts, and generates a reviewer and quiz engine the student can edit before finalizing.
caseStudy.challenges: Keeping generated content faithful to the source notes rather than hallucinating unrelated material.
